units.title: Normalize and solve a reciprocal functional equation
units.statement: A positive function satisfying x squared times f(xf(y))f(x)f(y)=c for every positive x,y must be f(x)=sqrt(c)/x. Normalize c to 1 and set F(x)=xf(x). Every value in the image of f is an anti-period of F, forcing F to be identically 1.
steps: Rescale the input by sqrt(c) to reduce to c=1
Use a=f(1), f(a)=a to the power -2, and the period and anti-period relations to force F=1
